Subject: Whoops — we missed you (quick 2-slot rescue)

Hi Samantha —

Looks like we missed each other for the walkthrough scheduled for 3:00 PM PT. No worries — I know calendars get messy. I wanted to offer two short options to get you back on the books quickly:

- Today 4:00–4:30 PM PT
- Tomorrow 11:00–11:30 AM PT

If neither works, grab a time on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/marcus-redwood/30min

I attached a short intro deck and a SOW template you can share with procurement if helpful. If you'd like, Monica (cc'd) can join the next call to run through onboarding and security questions.

Quick note on agenda: 15 min demo, 10 min pricing/ops fit, 5 min next steps.

Thanks — really looking forward to reconnecting.

Best,
